name: dandi
description: Dandi skills for Claude Code: feature specs verified against code and the running app, behavior-preserving refactoring, UI/UX guidelines for Korean users, a browser verification method, a Windows PC check-and-clean routine, and a board that lets sessions in the same folder see each other. Skill instructions are written in Korean.

plugins.name: dandi-feature-docs
plugins.description: Document every feature as AI-reproducible specs in docs/features/, run them as regression tests on the real screen, audit staleness, guard commits, convert tests to Playwright/Maestro scripts, and build release notes.

plugins.name: dandi-refactor
plugins.description: Behavior-preserving refactoring and optimization with side-effect verification; check mode verifies without changing code.

plugins.name: dandi-kr-ui-guide
plugins.description: UI/UX, icon, color, typography and design-token guidelines for web, app and game products aimed at Korean users, distilled from Korean service benchmarking research.

plugins.name: dandi-browser-check
plugins.description: Pick the right way to look at a page when verifying or debugging in a browser: HTTP fetch, page text, console and network, or a screenshot when the look itself is the question.

plugins.name: dandi-pc-clean
plugins.description: Check why a Windows PC got slow (orphaned node.exe, stale claude.exe sessions, old TEMP files, recycle bin, Outlook logging) read-only, then clean only the items you approve.

plugins.name: dandi-session-board
plugins.description: Let sessions in the same folder see each other: list other active sessions with their branch and edited files at session start, and warn once before editing a file another session changed. Hooks only, no model calls.
